subject: Taxes
title: Bitcoin's Tax Problem
description: A short lesson to help you apply Bitcoin's Tax Problem.

hook.text: The IRS declared Bitcoin property in 2014, not currency.

buildup.text: If Bitcoin is property, every time you spend it—buying coffee, paying rent.

discovery.text: A person who bought Bitcoin at $100 and spent it at $50,000 owes capital gains tax on $49,900.

twist.text: The famous 2010 Bitcoin pizza purchase—10,000 BTC for two pizzas.

climax.text: Treating crypto as property makes every purchase a tax event. The rules designed for stocks don't fit digital cash.

punchline.text: Buy pizza with Bitcoin, owe capital gains.

quiz.question: How does the IRS classify Bitcoin?
